talking_points.headline: Anthropic weighs a new model launch days after its own CEO called for an industry slowdown
talking_points.context_html: Six days after Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic publicly called for the industry to slow the pace of AI capability releases, Reuters reports Anthropic is weighing a competitive model launch anyway — a tension worth tracking for anyone betting change-execution roadmaps on vendor stability. HSBC's own AI build leans on Google Cloud's Gemini stack, but Wealth Intelligence and the next wave of RM-facing GenAI tools sit inside a fast-moving three-way race between OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, where safety posture and release cadence are now competitive signals in their own right, not just marketing.
source_links: Anthropic weighs new AI model ahead of IPO

talking_points.headline: Trump-Xi summit on 24 September adds a second macro catalyst for HK wealth books this month
talking_points.context_html: The summit lands three weeks after the Fed's first hike since 2023 tipped the Hang Seng into correction, so HSBC WPB's Hong Kong and Greater China books face a second event-risk window inside one month — with US Treasury's stance on penalising Chinese banks over Iran-linked ties the specific tail risk to watch, not the tariff headlines. For Adam, the action item is less about market direction and more about readiness: worth confirming Risk and the Hong Kong RM teams have a communication plan drafted before 24 September, not improvised after.
source_links: What to expect from the Trump-Xi summit

AI & Technology.title: Anthropic weighs releasing new AI model to counter OpenAI ahead of IPO
AI & Technology.summary: Following Dario Amodei's call for an industry-wide AI slowdown that we covered on 14 September, Reuters reports Anthropic is now weighing release of a new frontier model to counter the momentum OpenAI has built since launching GPT-6 Astra, with the decision complicated by an internal safety review and a possible IPO delay past the November US midterms. OpenRouter data shows OpenAI has overtaken Anthropic in enterprise API spend for the first time in over two years; Anthropic's annualised revenue run rate reportedly topped $65 billion by end-July.

Regulatory & Markets.title: Markets brace for 24 September Trump-Xi summit as HK, China equities in focus
Regulatory & Markets.summary: Trump and Xi are set to meet in Washington on 24 September, with a possible $30bn trade deal on the table alongside talks to extend a tariff truce expiring 10 November, and unresolved questions over US Treasury scrutiny of Chinese banks' financial ties to Iran. Analysts flag Hong Kong and China equities, semiconductors and rare-earth stocks as the likeliest sources of event-driven volatility running into the meeting.
